Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring informed consent prior to using mercury amalgam dental restorative material.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mercury amalgam dental restorative materials;and adding a new section to chapter 18.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) An individual licensed under this chapter shall provide apatient with information on the controversy surrounding mercury amalgamand seek the patient's informed consent prior to the use of mercuryamalgam dental restorative materials. (2) The commission shall produce a fact sheet on the controversysurrounding the use of mercury amalgam dental restorative materials anddistribute it to each individual licensed under this chapter.
